Fallen from Grace |quest_reward2_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward2_act = 6 |quest_reward2_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Phase Run''' is a [[skill gem]] that applies a [[buff]] to the character that grants increased [[movement speed]], increased [[stealth]], and [[Phasing]]. Using any skill while Phase Run is active will replace the primary buff with a secondary buff that grants more [[physical]] [[melee damage]] for a shorter duration. Phase Run consumes [[Frenzy Charge]]s to increase its duration. ==Skill functions and interactions== '''Duration''': Modifiers to skill effect [[duration]] or [[Buff#Buff duration|buff duration]] affect the duration of both the primary and secondary buffs. The secondary buff only begins once the primary buff expires or is removed early through using a skill. Using Phase Run again will reset the primary buff. '''Triggered skills''': [[Trigger]]ed skills do not count as "performed" and therefore do not cause Phase Run's primary buff to be replaced. '''Damage buff''' - The {{c|mod|more Melee Physical Damage}} modifier applies for the secondary duration after the character uses a skill. As hit damage is not [[snapshot|snapshotted]], the buff may expire before hit damage is calculated, though strike skills targeting nearby enemies will usually benefit from the buff regardless of attack time.https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3123794 - Question and answer game mechanics thread - author GGG staff. Release date 5/18/2021 - access date 5/19/2021 :Note that despite the skill's description suggesting otherwise, in-game testing indicates that the damage buff from Phase Run applies during ''both'' the primary and secondary duration, not just the secondary duration; therefore, using Phase Run after using a melee skill with a duration, such as {{il|Rage Vortex of Berserking}} or {{il|Earthquake}}, will buff the skill's damage for the entire duration of Phase Run.https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3357454https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zNEUCFhl8Ic ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Increased
